items.q: What did he find when he finally read the code?
items.a: Constructs with **plausible names** that weren't real—'skills' with no SKILL.md, 'agents' not on any agent SDK.

items.q: How did Codex blow the token budget?
items.a: It **wired unit tests to production inference** and ran ~30 cycles in a day.

items.q: What had the daily reflection agent been producing?
items.a: **Empty output**—the refactor silently broke its prompts.
**The agents did**—he directed how rubrics should be made, then edited them.
Agents **hill-climb to the rubric**; he **iterates the rubric** when the output isn't what he wants.
They **overfit the rubric** to one video; banning that made it **generalise and score higher**.

items.q: How does he make Claude and Codex keep each other honest?
Does he read every line now?
items.a: No—he **owns the goal and the rubric**, and spot-checks code.
